WTO Urges Global Trade Reforms Amidst Emerging Divisions

The World Trade Organization (WTO) has called for reforms to the global trade system, citing emerging divisions among member nations. The organization warned that a collapse of global trade rules could put countries, including Australia, at risk. The call for reform highlights a growing divergence in approaches to international trade.
